scope: This is a paired comparison within one CI runner, with fresh serial browser processes. Primary summaries are medians across independent process values; every process value and range is retained. Task CPU uses main-thread threadTicks; occupancy divides TaskDuration by the CDP Timestamp metric interval, which includes probe-result transfer. Map submissions and rAF rates divide counts by the probe capture interval. Map submissions are submitted map images; rAF is callback cadence; neither is physical display FPS. Fence values are the application's observed signal/polling delays, not actual GPU completion or display latency. They include polling cadence and SwiftShader; a long fence value does not establish visible lag. Held-key fence distributions include only signals observed in the capture: carry-in signals and unobserved tail submissions are counted separately. Held-key trajectories may diverge: retain public HUD poses/distances and art dimensions. One stationary or two moving processes per variant support descriptive comparisons, not confidence intervals. CPU profiles are separate later passes, only the seven preselected cases in repetition one. Replay comparisons require all four captures to retain the same ordered 32 trusted inputs and every projection/draw; otherwise comparative replay latency is withheld. Barrier-paced replay latency is not throughput or FPS. Replay identity is workload identity, not pixel equivalence. CPU includes observer and automation work.

audit.limits: Artifact metadata and preserved baseline resource identity are checked. Pages binaries are not present here: the workflow's package-byte verification is not independently repeated. These files do not authenticate GitHub API responses or physical display presentation.

environment.protocol: Each stationary scenario runs baseline then candidate. Moving scenarios run baseline/candidate then candidate/baseline (ABBA), in fresh browser processes on the same runner. CPU profiles are collected separately after timing, only in the first repetition.

profiles.scope: Separate post-timing sampling passes. Self/inclusive top tables retain the harness's top 45 nodes. Raw sample counts and exact delta weights are audited; no cross-package WASM-index matching or extra-case selection is inferred.
